dedupe_keys.name: dresden stormwater turbidity discharge and particle composition monitoring

description: This collection combines continuous turbidity and discharge monitoring with event-based particle analyses at a small urban catchment outlet in Dresden. TU Dresden researchers and collaborators provide online records from January 2018 through August 2022 and selected storm samples from September 2018 through 2021. Sample variables describe suspended-solids concentrations, fractions below and above sixty-three micrometres, elemental composition and organic content. OPARA lists CSV tables and a compressed duplicate of the main monitoring series, free under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Geographic coverage is one stormwater outlet; an exact uniform sampling interval was not established in the inspected metadata. Unequal monitoring and sample periods and the proxy relationship between turbidity and particulate pollutants are limitations. Modellers could calibrate wash-off or pollutant-transport formulations in urban drainage simulations, including model-epa-swmm. No CSV series or archive was downloaded, and no calibration or mass-balance calculation was performed.
